preconditions.expression: stdin.strip().split()[-1] == str and len(str) >= 2 and len(str) <= 500
preconditions.description: The input consists of a single line containing an integer N (2 ≤ N ≤ 500) followed by a string str of length N. The string must be non-empty and its length must be within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().isdigit() and int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for i in range(len(str)) for j in range(i + 1, len(str) + 1) if str[i:j] == str[i:j][::-1] and len(str[i:j]) >= 2)
postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the count of all palindromic substrings in str with length ≥ 2. A substring is palindromic if it reads the same forwards and backwards.
